name: Ireland
gaps: Many BirdWatch Ireland branches exist but lack their own websites; only major branches with dedicated sites are listed. Wexford, Offaly, Roscommon, and other counties have branches operating under the national organization.

groups.name: BirdWatch Ireland
groups.blurb: The national bird society with 15,000 members and 30 branches nationwide, running walks and monitoring schemes.

groups.name: BirdWatch Cork
groups.blurb: Cork branch of BirdWatch Ireland providing local birding information and organizing outings in the county.

groups.name: Clare Birdwatching
groups.blurb: Clare and Limerick region birding group providing local site guides and birdwatching information.

groups.name: BirdWatch Galway
groups.blurb: BirdWatch Ireland branch for Galway city and county, organizing regular walks and citizen science surveys.

groups.name: BirdWatch Mayo
groups.blurb: Mayo branch of BirdWatch Ireland welcoming members and visitors for regular birding outings and events.

groups.name: South Dublin Birds
groups.blurb: South Dublin branch focused on the south city and Dun Laoghaire/Rathdown catchment area.

groups.name: BWI Fingal
groups.blurb: North Dublin Fingal branch of BirdWatch Ireland for the northern suburban counties.

groups.name: Dublin Birding
groups.blurb: Tolka Valley birding group in Dublin providing local sightings and events in the northeast of the city.

name: Italy
gaps: LIPU has approximately 100 local sections across Italy. This list includes sections with verified websites; most smaller delegations lack standalone websites but operate through the main LIPU organization. Additional independent ornithological societies exist (S.O.I., SROPU, ASOIM) but are specialized research organizations.

LIPU Vibo (Calabria, Vibo Valentia): the delegazione's domain has lapsed and is now a for sale parking page, and no Facebook page of its own was findable, so it was dropped rather than published broken.

groups.name: LIPU
groups.blurb: National bird protection league with nearly 100 local sections, managing nature reserves and citizen science surveys across Italy.

groups.name: Società Ornitologica Italiana
groups.blurb: Italian ornithological society founded 1975, promoting scientific ornithological research and publishes Gli Uccelli d'Italia journal.

groups.name: LIPU Torino
groups.blurb: Turin regional delegazione of LIPU managing local conservation and education activities in northern Piedmont.

groups.name: LIPU Asti
groups.blurb: Asti delegazione running a wildlife recovery center for injured animals and organizing local conservation activities.

groups.name: LIPU Genova
groups.blurb: Genoa delegazione of LIPU coordinating bird conservation and education in the Liguria coastal region.

groups.name: LIPU Milano
groups.blurb: Milan delegazione of LIPU promoting urban conservation, habitat protection and environmental education in Lombardy.

groups.name: LIPU Brescia
groups.blurb: Brescia delegazione of LIPU working on local bird conservation and operating a wildlife emergency response service.

groups.name: LIPU Padova
groups.blurb: Padua delegazione providing birding activities, citizen science projects and habitat protection in the Veneto region.

groups.name: LIPU Venezia
groups.blurb: Venice section defending animals and nature, protecting endangered species and managing wildlife recovery in the lagoon.

groups.name: LIPU Treviso
groups.blurb: Treviso delegazione of LIPU coordinating conservation efforts in the northeastern Veneto region.

groups.name: LIPU Belluno
groups.blurb: Belluno delegazione of LIPU in the eastern Alps region organizing conservation and education activities.

groups.name: LIPU Reggio Emilia
groups.blurb: Reggio Emilia delegazione of LIPU coordinating bird conservation across the Emilia Romagna region.

groups.name: SROPU
groups.blurb: Roman Station for Bird Observation and Protection, one of Italy's oldest ornithological societies founded 1965.

groups.name: ASOIM
groups.blurb: Association for Ornithological Studies of Southern Italy focusing on research and bird conservation in the Puglia region.

groups.name: LIPU Rende
groups.blurb: Rende delegazione of LIPU working on conservation and education in the Calabria region of southern Italy.

groups.name: LIPU Palermo
groups.blurb: Palermo delegazione of LIPU coordinating bird protection and environmental conservation in western Sicily.

name: Malta
gaps: Malta has a small birding community. BirdLife Malta is the dominant organization. A public Birds of Malta Facebook group exists but has limited discoverability without logging in.

groups.name: BirdLife Malta
groups.blurb: Malta's national bird conservation organization founded 1962, managing nature reserves and running education programmes.

groups.name: Birds of Malta
groups.blurb: Community bird atlas and sighting platform with identification resources and species data for Malta.

name: San Marino
gaps: San Marino is a very small country with limited independent birding community organizations. Centro Naturalistico Sammarinese is a natural history museum and research center focused on ornithology, not a membership-based birding club. No other dedicated birding clubs or societies with public presence found.

groups.name: Centro Naturalistico Sammarinese
groups.blurb: Natural history museum and research institute with extensive ornithology collection and documentation of San Marino's avifauna.
